claims.text: Prasugrel and ticagrelor act faster and may be preferred for urgent PCI.

claims.text: If bleeding risk is a concern after PCI, can switch to aspirin or P2Y12 monotherapy after 1 month, or step down from ticagrelor/prasugrel to clopidogrel (less bleeding).
claims.quote: However, if bleeding risk is a concern, patients can be transitioned to monotherapy with aspirin or a P2Y12 inhibitor after 1 month, or de-escalated from ticagrelor or prasugrel to clopidogrel, which has a lower bleeding risk, as part of ongoing dual antiplatelet therapy.
